decision.outcome: option D reverted; guesser rules are back to commit c61a92a (same guesses, GUESS_RULES structure kept)
decision.reason: Option D improved train - val agreement by +2 prompts (67.7% -> 68.1%) but lost 2 on validation (73.5% -> 71.8%, 0 fixed / 2 broken), so it was reverted under this phase's rule: a change replaces the current one only on a validation win.
decision.follow_up: Keyword tuning has hit diminishing returns (+/-3 prompts). An embedding-based task classifier is the follow-up if Part F shows task type matters.
decision.feature_version: 3 (features identical to v2; bumped because Part F retrains on the fit set)

notes: Keyword tuning has hit diminishing returns: every keyword variant tried moved agreement by about +/-3 prompts (fit: baseline 67.7% -> option D 68.1%; validation confirmation: 73.5% -> 71.8%, 2 prompts broken, none fixed).

The remaining gaps are not keyword-shaped: coding prompts that only name a library or framework (vue, mssql, weaviate, ...), open_ended (0% recall, the guesser has no rule that can output it), and creative (3% recall on fit).
An embedding-based task classifier is a possible follow-up, depending on the Part F results (hand-tag vs guessed-task-type classifiers compared on validation).
